senses.en: relating to the geological era from about 252 to 66 million years ago, including the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous periods

example.en: Dinosaurs dominated the Mesozoic world.
example.zh: 恐龙统治着中生代的世界。

senses.en: the Mesozoic era of geological time

example.en: The Mesozoic ended with a mass extinction.
example.zh: 中生代以一次大灭绝结束。

senses.en: indicating purpose or intended recipient

example.en: This gift is for you.
example.zh: 这份礼物是给你的。

senses.en: because; used to introduce a reason (formal)

example.en: He stayed home, for he was tired.
example.zh: 他待在家里，因为他累了。

senses.en: every person; everyone

example.en: Everybody wants to be happy.
example.zh: 每个人都想快乐。

senses.en: to state something again in order to confirm it

example.en: The government reaffirmed its commitment to education reform.
example.zh: 政府重申了对教育改革的承诺。

senses.en: correct and exact, especially in details or measurements

example.en: The report gives an accurate description of the accident.
example.zh: 这份报告对事故作了准确的描述。

senses.en: the inner part or surface of something

example.en: The inside of the box was lined with paper.
example.zh: 盒子内部衬着纸。

senses.en: on or near the inner side of something

example.en: He put the letter in his inside pocket.
example.zh: 他把信放进了内袋。

senses.en: within the limits or space of something

example.en: The cat is inside the house.
example.zh: 猫在房子里。

senses.en: help or assistance given to someone or something

example.en: The volunteers gave aid to the flood victims.
example.zh: 志愿者向洪水受灾者提供了援助。

senses.en: to help or assist someone or something

example.en: The map aided the hikers in finding the trail.
example.zh: 地图帮助徒步者找到了小径。

senses.en: a person or thing that helps make something easier

example.en: The teacher used pictures as a visual aid.
example.zh: 老师用图片作为视觉辅助工具。

senses.en: a company or business that makes products, usually in large quantities

example.en: The manufacturer recalled the defective batteries.
example.zh: 制造商召回了有缺陷的电池。

senses.en: a person whose business is making goods
senses.zh: 制造者；从事制造业的人

example.en: He worked as a textile manufacturer before retiring.
example.zh: 退休前他是一名纺织品制造商。

senses.en: to judge or measure the quality, value, or importance of something

example.en: The committee will evaluate the proposal next week.
example.zh: 委员会将于下周评估该提案。

senses.en: to calculate the value of a mathematical expression

example.en: Students learn to evaluate simple algebraic expressions.
example.zh: 学生学习求简单代数表达式的值。

senses.en: to give someone energy or enthusiasm; to make someone feel lively

example.en: The coach's speech energized the team before the game.
example.zh: 教练的赛前讲话激励了全队。

senses.en: to supply electricity or energy to something

example.en: Technicians energized the new power line this morning.
example.zh: 技术人员今天上午给新输电线路通电了。

senses.en: a tool with a long handle and bristles, used for sweeping floors

example.en: She picked up the broom and swept the kitchen floor.
example.zh: 她拿起扫帚扫了厨房的地板。

senses.en: a shrub with yellow flowers and slender green branches
senses.zh: 金雀花（一种开黄花的灌木）

example.en: The hillside was covered with flowering broom.
example.zh: 山坡上开满了金雀花。

senses.en: to sweep with or as if with a broom

example.en: He broomed the sand off the doorstep.
example.zh: 他把门前的沙子扫掉了。

senses.en: to give a person or institution a permanent source of income, typically through a donation

example.en: The businessman endowed a new library at the university.
example.zh: 这位商人向大学捐赠了一座新图书馆。

senses.en: to naturally give someone a quality, ability, or talent
senses.zh: 赋予（才能、品质）；天生具有

example.en: She is endowed with great intelligence.
example.zh: 她天资聪颖。

senses.en: something that results from a process or event

example.en: The resultant of the merger was a stronger company.
example.zh: 合并的结果是一家更强大的公司。

senses.en: a single force that has the same effect as two or more forces combined

example.en: The resultant of the two forces points to the right.
example.zh: 这两个力的合力指向右边。

senses.en: happening as a consequence of something
senses.zh: 因而发生的；由此导致的

example.en: Heavy rain caused flooding and resultant damage to the roads.
example.zh: 暴雨引发洪水，导致道路受损。

senses.en: used to say the exact hour of the clock

example.en: The meeting starts at three o'clock.
example.zh: 会议三点钟开始。

senses.en: relating to Australia or its people
senses.zh: 澳大利亚的；澳大利亚人的

example.en: They enjoyed an Australian barbecue on the beach.
example.zh: 他们在海滩上享用了一顿澳大利亚式烧烤。

senses.en: a person from Australia

example.en: Many Australians love surfing.
example.zh: 许多澳大利亚人喜欢冲浪。

senses.en: a shade or variety of a color

example.en: The sky changed from a golden hue to deep orange.
example.zh: 天空从金色色调变成了深橙色。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Charles works as an engineer in London.
example.zh: 查尔斯在伦敦当工程师。

senses.en: a student in the first year of high school or college
senses.zh: （美国中学或大学的）一年级新生

example.en: My sister is a freshman at the state university this year.
example.zh: 我姐姐今年是州立大学的一年级新生。

senses.en: a newcomer to an activity or organization

example.en: As a freshman in the company, he asked many questions.
example.zh: 作为公司的新人，他问了很多问题。

senses.en: (of a price or cost) so high that it prevents people from buying or doing something
senses.zh: （价格等）高得让人望而却步的

example.en: The cost of housing in the city is prohibitive for young workers.
example.zh: 这座城市的房价对年轻上班族来说高得难以承受。

senses.en: a person who owns or runs an inn

example.en: The innkeeper welcomed the tired travellers warmly.
example.zh: 客栈老板热情地接待了疲惫的旅客。

senses.en: tasting very good (informal)

example.en: This cake is absolutely yummy.
example.zh: 这个蛋糕真是太好吃了。

senses.en: fair and generous behavior in sports and competition

example.en: He congratulated his opponent, showing true sportsmanship.
example.zh: 他向对手表示祝贺，展现了真正的体育精神。

senses.en: not neat or well cared for; messy in appearance

example.en: He arrived with unkempt hair and a wrinkled shirt.
example.zh: 他头发蓬乱、衬衫皱巴巴地来了。

senses.en: a piece of music performed by two singers or players

example.en: They performed a beautiful piano duet.
example.zh: 他们演奏了一首优美的钢琴二重奏。

senses.en: a place where aircraft take off and land

example.en: The small planes were parked at the airfield.
example.zh: 小型飞机停放在机场上。

senses.en: the crime of offering or giving money or gifts to influence someone improperly

example.en: The official was charged with bribery.
example.zh: 这名官员被控受贿。

senses.en: causing horror or disgust; gruesome
senses.zh: 可怕的；令人毛骨悚然的

example.en: The movie described a grisly crime scene.
example.zh: 这部电影描述了一个可怕的犯罪现场。

senses.en: in classical mythology, a minor goddess of nature, often shown as a beautiful young woman

example.en: According to legend, a nymph lived in the forest spring.
example.zh: 传说中，一位仙女住在林中泉水边。

senses.en: the young form of an insect such as a dragonfly, before full adult development

example.en: The dragonfly nymph lives underwater for years.
example.zh: 蜻蜓的若虫会在水下生活多年。

senses.en: activity and concern aimed at protecting the natural environment

example.en: Environmentalism has shaped government policy for decades.
example.zh: 环境保护主义几十年来一直在影响政府政策。

senses.en: the theory that environment, rather than heredity, shapes development

example.en: The debate contrasted environmentalism with genetic explanations.
example.zh: 这场辩论将环境决定论与遗传解释加以对比。

senses.en: to make it easier for someone to do something

example.en: Can you help me carry these boxes?
example.zh: 你能帮我搬这些箱子吗？

senses.en: assistance or support given to someone

example.en: She gave me a lot of help with the project.
example.zh: 她在这个项目上给了我很多帮助。

senses.en: to form letters or words on a surface

example.en: Please write your name at the top of the page.
example.zh: 请在这页顶部写下你的名字。

senses.en: to compose a text such as a book, story, or report

example.en: She writes short stories in her spare time.
example.zh: 她空闲时写短篇小说。

senses.en: to send a letter or message to someone

example.en: I'll write to you as soon as I arrive.
example.zh: 我一到就给你写信。

senses.en: to store data in a file or on a device

example.en: The program writes the results to a log file.
example.zh: 程序把结果写入日志文件。

senses.en: a flat circular object or part

example.en: She placed the disk on the table.
example.zh: 她把圆盘放在桌子上。

senses.en: a device or medium used to store computer data

example.en: Save the file to the disk.
example.zh: 把文件保存到磁盘上。

senses.en: A piece of absorbent cloth used for drying the body or things.

example.en: She grabbed a towel after her shower.
example.zh: 她洗完澡后拿了一条毛巾。

senses.en: To dry or rub someone or something with a towel.

example.en: He toweled his hair dry.
example.zh: 他用毛巾把头发擦干。

senses.en: a person whose job is to teach students in a school or college

example.en: The teacher explained the lesson clearly.
example.zh: 老师清楚地讲解了这节课。

senses.en: a person who teaches a particular skill to others

example.en: My swimming teacher helped me feel confident in the water.
example.zh: 我的游泳教练帮助我在水里变得自信。

senses.en: an experience or event that teaches someone a lesson
senses.zh: 给人以教益的事物；教训

example.en: Failure can be a harsh teacher.
example.zh: 失败可能是一位严厉的老师。

senses.en: the usual weather conditions in a place

example.en: The island has a warm climate all year.
example.zh: 这个岛屿全年气候温暖。

senses.en: the general mood or conditions of a situation

example.en: The economic climate is making people cautious.
example.zh: 经济形势使人们变得谨慎。

senses.en: a person who decides cases in a court of law

example.en: The judge sentenced him to two years in prison.
example.zh: 法官判处他两年监禁。

senses.en: to form an opinion about someone or something

example.en: Don't judge people by their appearance.
example.zh: 不要以貌取人。

senses.en: a person who decides the winner in a competition

example.en: The judges gave the singer top marks.
example.zh: 评委给那位歌手打了最高分。

senses.en: to act as a judge in a court or competition

example.en: She judged the baking contest last year.
example.zh: 她去年担任烘焙比赛的评委。

senses.en: a nocturnal bird of prey with a large head, forward-facing eyes and a hawk-like beak

example.en: An owl hooted softly in the trees outside the window.
example.zh: 窗外树上一只猫头鹰轻轻地叫了一声。

senses.en: the amount of money a business takes in through sales in a period

example.en: The company's annual turnover reached ten million dollars.
example.zh: 该公司的年营业额达到了一千万美元。

senses.en: the rate at which employees leave a company and are replaced

example.en: High staff turnover makes training new workers expensive.
example.zh: 员工流动率高使得培训新员工的成本很高。

senses.en: the rate at which goods are sold or money moves within a business

example.en: Faster inventory turnover means the store uses its stock efficiently.
example.zh: 更快的库存周转意味着这家商店高效地利用了存货。

senses.en: a small pastry folded over a sweet or savory filling
senses.zh: 酥皮馅饼（一种折叠烘烤的点心）

example.en: She baked apple turnovers for dessert.
example.zh: 她烤了苹果酥皮馅饼当甜点。

senses.en: to mean, represent, or be a sign of something

example.en: A red light signifies danger.
example.zh: 红灯表示危险。

senses.en: to make a meaning known, often by a gesture or action

example.en: She signified her agreement with a nod.
example.zh: 她点头表示同意。

senses.en: a difference between two things that should be the same

example.en: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
example.zh: 这两份报告之间存在差异。

senses.en: a pile of things placed on top of each other

example.en: The clothes lay in a heap on the floor.
example.zh: 衣服成堆地躺在地板上。

senses.en: a large number or amount of something

example.en: We have heaps of time before the train leaves.
example.zh: 火车开走之前我们有很多时间。

senses.en: to pile things up, or to give someone a lot of something

example.en: They heaped praise on the young pianist.
example.zh: 他们对这位年轻的钢琴家大加赞扬。

senses.en: used to introduce a remark or question that is not directly related to what was said before
senses.zh: 顺便说一句；附带提一句

example.en: Incidentally, have you heard from Tom recently?
example.zh: 顺便问一句，你最近有汤姆的消息吗？

senses.en: in a way that is not central or planned; as a minor point or by chance

example.en: The book mentions, only incidentally, the author's childhood.
example.zh: 这本书只是顺带提到了作者的童年。

senses.en: to throw away or get rid of something you no longer want

example.en: She discarded the old magazines to make room on the shelf.
example.zh: 她把旧杂志扔掉，好腾出架子上的空间。

senses.en: something that has been thrown away

example.en: The pile of discards grew as they cleared out the garage.
example.zh: 他们清理车库时，丢弃物越堆越多。

senses.en: a card thrown away in a card game

example.en: He had no hearts, so he made a discard.
example.zh: 他没有红桃，只好垫了一张牌。

senses.en: a person who supports socialism
senses.zh: 社会主义者；社会党党员

example.en: As a socialist, she believes the government should provide free healthcare.
example.zh: 作为一名社会主义者，她认为政府应该提供免费医疗。

senses.en: relating to or supporting socialism

example.en: The country adopted socialist policies after the revolution.
example.zh: 该国在革命后采取了社会主义政策。

senses.en: the hard outer layer of bread

example.en: I like the crust of fresh bread.
example.zh: 我喜欢新鲜面包的外皮。

senses.en: the outer layer of the Earth

example.en: Earthquakes happen in the Earth's crust.
example.zh: 地震发生在地壳中。

senses.en: to form or cover with a hard outer layer

example.en: The snow crusted overnight.
example.zh: 雪在夜间结成了硬壳。

senses.en: to walk slowly and leisurely, often for pleasure

example.en: We strolled along the beach at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时分我们沿着海滩漫步。

senses.en: a slow, relaxed walk

example.en: They went for a stroll after dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭后他们出去散步了。

senses.en: allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be seen clearly

example.en: The glass window is transparent, so we can see the garden outside.
example.zh: 玻璃窗是透明的，所以我们能看到外面的花园。

senses.en: easy to understand or notice; open and honest

example.en: The company promised to be transparent about its finances.
example.zh: 该公司承诺在财务方面保持公开透明。

senses.en: the mind, or a person's thoughts and feelings as a whole

example.en: The accident had a lasting effect on his psyche.
example.zh: 那次事故对他的心理造成了持久的影响。

senses.en: relating to the heart

example.en: The patient was admitted to the cardiac care unit.
example.zh: 病人被送进了心脏监护病房。

senses.en: the act of registering for a school, course, or organization

example.en: Enrolment for the new term begins next week.
example.zh: 新学期的注册下周开始。

senses.en: the number of people registered

example.en: The school's enrolment has doubled in five years.
example.zh: 这所学校的入学人数五年内翻了一番。

senses.en: a robbery, especially at gunpoint

example.en: The police arrested two men after a holdup at the bank.
example.zh: 银行发生持械抢劫后，警方逮捕了两名男子。

senses.en: a delay or stoppage

example.en: The traffic holdup made us late for the meeting.
example.zh: 交通堵塞让我们开会迟到了。

senses.en: attractive; looking good on someone

example.en: That color is very becoming on you.
example.zh: 那颜色穿在你身上很好看。

senses.en: proper and appropriate in behavior

example.en: She gave a becoming reply to the rude question.
example.zh: 她对那个无礼的问题作了得体的回应。

senses.en: young people who are not yet adults; sons or daughters of any age (plural of child)
senses.zh: 孩子们；子女（child 的复数）

example.en: The children played in the park all afternoon.
example.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在公园里玩耍。

senses.en: a small whirlpool or circular current in water, air or smoke

example.en: Leaves were trapped in an eddy near the riverbank.
example.zh: 树叶被卷进了河岸边的一个漩涡。

senses.en: to move in a circular current

example.en: The smoke eddied around the campfire.
example.zh: 烟雾在篝火旁打着旋。

senses.en: a single complete turn or a rotating, spiralling movement

example.en: The dancer's rapid gyrations amazed the audience.
example.zh: 舞者快速的旋转令观众惊叹。

collocations: the gyrations of the stock market

senses.en: to obtain something, especially with effort or through formal means

example.en: They managed to procure the equipment before the deadline.
example.zh: 他们在截止日期前设法弄到了设备。

senses.en: to decorate fabric with stitched patterns using a needle and thread

example.en: She embroidered flowers on the pillowcase.
example.zh: 她在枕套上绣了花。

senses.en: to add invented details to a story to make it more interesting

example.en: He embroidered the story to make it more exciting.
example.zh: 他把故事添油加醋，讲得更加精彩。

senses.en: lack of respect or rude behavior toward someone or something

example.en: His comments showed disrespect toward the staff.
example.zh: 他的言论表现出对员工的不敬。

senses.en: to treat someone without respect

example.en: He accused them of disrespecting their elders.
example.zh: 他指责他们不尊重长辈。

senses.en: an object believed to have magical powers

example.en: In some traditions, a fetish is kept as a protective charm.
example.zh: 在某些传统中，神物被当作护身符保存。

senses.en: a strong sexual attraction to an object or body part

example.en: The film explores how a fetish develops in a person's mind.
example.zh: 这部电影探讨了恋物心理是如何形成的。

senses.en: an excessive interest in or need for something

example.en: He has a fetish for neatness that annoys his roommates.
example.zh: 他对整洁的痴迷让室友们很恼火。

senses.en: comparative of strong: having more physical power or strength

example.en: Regular exercise made her much stronger.
example.zh: 经常锻炼让她强壮了许多。

senses.en: more intense in effect, flavor, or smell

example.en: This coffee tastes stronger than the one I made yesterday.
example.zh: 这杯咖啡比我昨天冲的味道更浓。

senses.en: more powerful economically or in influence
senses.zh: 更强劲的；更有影响力的

example.en: The economy is stronger this year than last year.
example.zh: 今年经济比去年更强劲。
